name: tpl-chain-response-2-nogoal
task: Each time the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move. If you reach the exit, you must be carrying the box.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the original task requires the agent to pick up the box on its very next move when it falls, but the candidate clause R1 pick up the box again on your very next move is wrong because it requires the box to be already picked up, whereas the task requires the agent to pick it up when it falls. To fix, replace R1 with Existence(box_fell), because the task requires the box to fall, and pick it up again is a rule that is already covered by R2. Remove R1, because it only repeats what R2 already requires.

CHANGES REQUIRED: the task requires reaching the exit while carrying the box, but no clause makes the box stay in the hands; add a hard ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box) to force the box back into the hands after every fall.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: the given clauses, ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box) and RespondedExistence(at_exit, holding_box), correctly capture the task requirements of picking up the box again on the very next move after it falls and reaching the exit while carrying the box.
